desc: Whether you're entering the world of EDC or looking to add a knife to your rotation that provides a huge bang for the buck, look no further than the Airlock. The triangular design elements of this model echo the shape of a stealth plane, and the Airlock continues this theme with a reversible pocket clip that's as inconspicuous as a pen cap, perfect for subtle carry. For added style, the Airlock has a slim look with a distinctive cutout in the handle that mirrors its shape. This “airlock” lets you see through to the stainless steel liners, adding an aerodynamic feel that recalls the knife's light weight. Made with pride by Kershaw Knives – you can trust the quality and experience with any Kershaw product.
